home.heroTitle: True Italian Flavours, Crafted with Passion.
home.heroCopy: Fresh handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza, and warm family hospitality every day.
home.menuCardCopy: Explore handcrafted regional specialties, bronze-cut pasta, and Mediterranean seafood.
home.reservationCardCopy: An intimate table for two, a family feast, or a slow evening with vintage Chianti.
home.signatureSubtitle: Icons of Italian tradition crafted with pure passion.
home.philosophyCopy: Born from devotion to timeless Italian hospitality, Tre Fratelli unites Marco's pasta craft, Matteo's wood-fired fire, and Luca's sommelier cellar. Every dish tells our heritage.

restaurant.title: Our Heritage & Story
restaurant.subtitle: HONEST INGREDIENTS, FAMILY DEVOTION
restaurant.story1: Tre Fratelli was born from the bond of three brothers who grew up surrounded by the aromas of slow-simmered ragù and freshly baked bread in southern Italy.
restaurant.story2: Every morning begins with stone-ground flour and farm-fresh eggs on the wooden pastry board. We source cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil directly from small groves in Puglia, San Marzano tomatoes from Campania, and wild herbs.
restaurant.pillar1Copy: No shortcuts, no artificial additions. True Italian cuisine relies on raw ingredient quality and unhurried patience.
restaurant.pillar2Copy: We welcome every guest as if they were stepping into our grandmother's dining room on a Sunday afternoon.
restaurant.pillar3Copy: Every wine bottle and regional recipe reflects the microclimate and soil of Italy's greatest culinary valleys.

pizzeria.title: La Nostra Pizzeria
pizzeria.subtitle: THE ART OF DOUGH & 450°C WOOD FIRE
pizzeria.story: Our pizza dough undergoes a gentle 48-hour cold fermentation, giving it an airy crust that is extraordinarily light and digestible. Baked in our hand-built volcanic brick oven.
pizzeria.step1Desc: Cold-matured sourdough dough for exceptional lightness and natural digestibility.
pizzeria.step2Desc: Skillfully opened by hand from center to rim to protect the airy alveoli.
pizzeria.step3Desc: San Marzano plum tomatoes, creamy Campanian buffalo mozzarella, and fresh sweet basil.
pizzeria.step4Desc: Intense flash baking over beechwood embers creating the signature leopard-spotted cornicione.

karaokeHighlight.title: Serate di Musica & Karaoke: Sing, Dine & Celebrate
karaokeHighlight.description: Known across the Milan metro area for hearty Italian hospitality, Tre Fratelli hosts vibrant weekend nights with live singing, Sanremo classics, hot wood-fired pizzas, and cold beers. Perfect for family celebrations, birthdays, and friends gathering around one big table.
karaokeHighlight.feature1: Live microphones & song requests for all guests

privateEvents.description: Spacious rooms accommodating large parties, tailored fixed-price menus (€10–€20), festive karaoke entertainment, and complimentary private parking make Tre Fratelli the ideal venue for your celebration in Trezzano sul Naviglio.
